en: Her name's Irene Tirnag, and she lives with an owl in a tall tower in a place called Darg on Bremes Isle.{wait}{clear}She's a mage girl, and she studies magic super hard every single day.{wait}{clear}Her grandpa was a mage too, so it's kinda like she's carrying on his wishes.{wait}{clear}And Florin thinks she's looking into something really, really important.{wait}{clear}I can feel strong magic in her, so I bet she'll be a great hero! Go meet her, okay, Angel?

Her name's Leyla Vigrid, and I found her in Reizefut, the capital of Reizefut in the Grosain Empire.{wait}{clear}She's an imperial knight, and guess what? She's the very first woman ever to become a knight!{wait}{clear}I bet she's super amazing with a sword! Wowww! But right now she's been thrown in jail.{wait}{clear}I don't know why, but Florin's sure she's not a bad person! Angel, please help her!

Her name's Cecia, and I found her in Leiria, in Fes, in the untamed lands.{wait}{clear}She's a daughter of the clan that lives in the Reyforia Forest, which covers almost all of the untamed lands, and she's super good with a bow!{wait}{clear}And she seems really pure, with a strong sense of justice. I couldn't find out much, but she kinda seemed to look up to angels, too.{wait}{clear}So I'm sure she'll help you, Angel! Go meet her, okay?
